Jun 2026 • Couples
This wonderful restaurant,we found quite by chance.We went for a walk and found a cozy place to eat a little bit.We didn't want to eat because in a couple of hours we had dinner with friends.We really liked the entrance and the cozy tables in front of the entrance and decided to come in.We were very warmly welcomed by a girl named Hoa.She was very kind so we met her.When she brought us the dish, she asked if we knew how to eat it properly and gladly showed us when we said we didn't.We were in Vietnam for the first time and wanted to try all the dishes that look delicious, but how to eat them correctly we didn't always know.We ordered barbecues and they turned out to be spring rolls 😁It was very good. I want to come in here again and again!
